If destination is a directory, source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed. So to copy to Archives with new name, we need to specify destination as "ArchivedFinalReport2024.txt"? But that would copy into current directory? Actually cp: source: string, destination: string. If destination is a directory, source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed. So we need to cd into Archives first, then cp? But cp source must be local to current directory. If we cd into Archives, source must be local to Archives. But FinalReport.txt is not in Archives. So can\'t. Alternative: use mv? No. We can use cp to copy into current directory, then rename. But we want to preserve original.
